verdict.rationale: Daily's public Video SDK pricing page is metered in participant-minutes. It publishes 10,000 free participant minutes, a concrete add-on rate (Krisp noise cancellation at $0.0002/participant minute), flat pricing with no HD surcharge, and free self-serve signup, so no sales contact is implied. However, the pack never shows the core per-participant-minute rate for video or audio calls, so a founder cannot fully model base cost from this evidence. Missing for 10: the published base per-participant-minute price for video/audio sessions, recording/streaming/transcription unit rates, and independent corroboration that the full rate card is self-serve.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
